statement: Landmark empties were appended as children of FOOT.L/R. Stripping them must give the pre-landmark JSON (canonical JSON.stringify) and BIN chunk exactly; mesh, skin and animation data are unchanged.

adult_male.note: T-D7-05 (2026-10-30): rig rebuilt with an MTP toe joint (TOE.L/R); before_sha256 is the landmark-free file reconstructed by stripping the landmark nodes.

BALL_L.source: SKELETAL.METATARSALS_AND_PHALANGES_COMBINED.L (posterior metatarsal part of the forefoot, proximal to the derived MTP plane; not MT1 and not the toe part)

BALL_R.source: SKELETAL.METATARSALS_AND_PHALANGES_COMBINED.R (posterior metatarsal part of the forefoot, proximal to the derived MTP plane; not MT1 and not the toe part)

vhf_denver_ct_adult_female.note: Correction (review of #2918): the female BALL landmark was sourced from the combined forefoot including the TOE-bound phalangeal part, so it sat on a segment that moves with TOE while parented to FOOT. It is now sourced only from the FOOT-bound posterior metatarsal part (proximal to the derived MTP plane). before_sha256 is the landmark-free file reconstructed by stripping the landmark nodes; the strip is verified by before_json_canonical_sha256 and bin_sha256.
